profile.headline: Web Developer and Digital Marketing Professional at Consultant
profile.jobTitle: Web Developer and Digital Marketing Professional
profile.summary:
Data driven web design and digital marketing professional with 10+ years of experience designing corporate websites and promoting brands. Proficient in graphic design, front-end development, data analysis, and digital marketing (search engine optimization, pay per click) which enables me to think holistically in developing solutions to increase sales.

Digital projects include: responsive web design, wireframing mockups, landing page design, email marketing campaign templates, web banners, web standards, redesigning company websites and microsites, ecommerce search engine optimization

 My driven  passion for an urge to create things. I Am  also a team player who knows that it takes a team to develop great projects. I enjoy collaborating with colleagues and clients, and will voluntarily help and teach whenever needed. I have  very good analytical skills, high ability to find realistic e-solutions such as re-engineering web components to be more user-friendly and customized, design and implement applications for a very high traffic and large-scale websites.

Experienced in PHP, MySQL, HTML, CSS, jQurey, As3, Ranking, SEO and SEM and it happens that I Am also a fast learner who loves to read and learn more about technology, especially when its relates to my field (web in general), and I believe that the better developer is the one who can develop his own skills faster with a better QUALITY.

I am looking for a career where I can put that mild obsession to use in the development of information interaction on the web. The web is amazing in it’s infinite possibilities, and in how it is constantly changing and improving upon itself. Part of the exciting challenge of being a part of web development is keeping up with all of the new and emerging technologies such as HTML5, CSS3, AJAX and cloud computing.

positions.title: Web Developer and Digital Marketing Professional
positions.description:
Work collaboratively with clients and in-house agency teams to provide
robust front and back-end web development optimizing user experience, brand
positioning, lead generation, email marketing and related reporting and analysis.Perform user experience research, develop information architectures and create web page wireframes, track usage, trends and conversions via web analytic software.

positions.title: Digital Media Specialist
positions.description: Primary focus in front end/UI development but also involved throughout entire project life cycle from discovery and requirements building, to development of wireframes and design concepts (mock ups), development of markup (HTML), presentation (CSS) and behavior (JavaScript) and implementation.

positions.title: Digital Marketing Consultant
positions.description:
Consulting services to provide entrepreneurs and small businesses with the opportunity to reach their marketing goals using a variety social media tools and web 2.0 marketing strategies.  offering social media, marketing and web consulting and development services to help businesses leverage social platforms
like: Facebook, Twitter, YouTube, LinkedIn and more. My goal is for my clients to have a consistent
online brand and presence, while helping them discover which social media tools are best to grow their business.
I use semantic HTML5, well supported CSS3 and JavaScript to create rich, responsive experiences for our clients'​ websites and applications, optimized for their users.

positions.title: Web Developer and IT Support
positions.description:
* Responsible for the maintenance of Chamber members database and website
* Software and hardware troubleshooting support for internal staff
* Design visual materials and created promotional graphics for diverse events
* Support users
o Composed HTML layout 
o Enhanced sidebar navigation using Java Script.
o Created flow diagram of this section of site for client.
o Refined DHTML drop-down menu to function properly in both IE and Netscape. This was a production
issue which needed quick attention and immediate remedy.
o Created new pages and created graphics 
o Converted total Flash site into HTML keeping the Flash which was necessary. Original design of this site
was hard to navigate and too lengthy in download times due to overuse of Flash.
o Redesigned look and layout to improve customer experience and ease of navigation and flow. o Created test scripts for client to run tests on site redesign.

company.name: The Greater Dallas Hispanic Chamber of Commerce

positions.title: Senior communications manager
positions.description:
HYP Network is the leading independent publisher of Spanish language yellow page directories in the United States. The Company presently publishes directories in Tampa, Miami and Orlando, FL, Chicago, IL, Dallas and Houston, TX, Washington, DC, Baltimore, Maryland and Virginia. The Company is majority owned by ABRY Partners of Boston.

ABRY Partners, based in Boston, MA, is one of the oldest and largest private equity funds in North America investing exclusively in media, entertainment and communications companies. ABRY has $3.0 billion of capital under management and since 1989 has completed over $16.0 billion of leveraged acquisitions and other media sector private equity transactions.

Proven ability to serve as the sole trainer on key customer accounts, to act as the senior
trainer supporting new trainees, to conduct Train-the Trainer courses, and to provide
product sales training for internal salespeople and internal staff. Provided solutions to
multiple technical and business issues with organization-wide impact.
• Created and migrated all database objects through various development, testing,
and production environments.
• Create software documentation
• Provide customer training to Systems Administrators, Managers, Supervisors,
Team Leads, and Trainers in all areas of the organization utilizing the software
application suite.
• Act as the senior trainer responsible for providing support to new trainees
through mentoring, observation, and feedback.
• Create all step-by-step training documentation for Web Applications.

company.name: Hispanic Yellow Pages - Directorio en Espanol

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description:
Created the new directory publishing and business management software From lead
generation, canvass management and commissions...through contract entry and
account maintenance...continuing on to account billing and collections. In this process I
studied the process, designed the system, developed and tested the whole project and
implemented the same which is running efficiently in the concern. I worked with
database SQL and Visual Basic.

positions.title: Analyst and Reporting Specialist
positions.description: Design and execute automated procedures interfacing with systems to report business analytics and sales support indicators. Enquire from management, sales, departments and affiliates on data systems and reports.

positions.title: Data Analyst
positions.description: Collect, review and log data totals into database for reporting and ensure accuracy and report deliverables’ timelines. Oversee reports and deliverables complying with administrative invoicing.
